name: External Payment Cancellation Rejection 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for the rejection of a cancellation, as published in an external payment cancellation rejection code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

AC04.name: Closed Account Number
AC04.definition: Account number specified has been closed on the receiver’s books.

ADAC.name: Awaiting Debit Authority From Customer
ADAC.definition: Reported when the cancellation request cannot be processed because customer has not yet provided the debit authority on its account.

AGNT.name: Agent Decision
AGNT.definition: Reported when the cancellation cannot be accepted because of an agent refuses to cancel.

AM04.name: Insufficient Funds
AM04.definition: Amount of funds available to cover specified message amount is insufficient.

ARDT.name: Already Returned
ARDT.definition: Cancellation not accepted as the transaction has already been returned.

ARPL.name: Awaitin Reply
ARPL.definition: Reported when the cancellation request cannot be processed because no reply has been  received yet from the receiver of the request message.

CUST.name: Customer Decision
CUST.definition: Reported when the cancellation cannot be accepted because of a customer decision (Creditor).

LEGL.name: Legal Decision
LEGL.definition: Reported when the cancellation cannot be accepted because of regulatory rules.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: Reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.

NOAS.name: No Answer From Customer
NOAS.definition: No response from beneficiary (to the cancellation request).

NOOR.name: No Original Transaction Received
NOOR.definition: Original transaction (subject to cancellation) never received.

PTNA.name: Passed To The Next Agent
PTNA.definition: Reported when the cancellation request cannot be accepted because the payment instruction has been passed to the next agent.

RQDA.name: Requesting Debit Authority
RQDA.definition: Reported when authority is required by the Creditor to return the payment.

WSEQ.name: Wrong Sequence
WSEQ.definition: Reported when the cancellation request cannot be processed because the sequence referred to in the request is not valid.

INDM.name: Cancellation Indemnity Required
INDM.definition: Complementing a Pending or Reject Status. Payment cancellation request cannot be accepted until an indemnity agreement is established.

AEXR.name: Already Expired RTP
AEXR.definition: Request-to-pay Expiry Date and Time has already passed.

ARFR.name: Already Refused RTP
ARFR.definition: Request-to-pay has already been refused by the Debtor.

PATE.name: Payment Already Transmitted Execution
PATE.definition: Payment related to the request-to-pay has already been transmitted for execution.

RCAR.name: Rf C Already Rejected
RCAR.definition: Request for cancellation of the request-to-pay has already been rejected.

RCNR.name: Rf C Never Received
RCNR.definition: Request for cancellation of the request-to-pay has never been received.

RCPR.name: Rf C Received And Processed
RCPR.definition: Request for cancellation of the request-to-pay has already been received and processed.
